fullText.simplified:
第23章、理由是什么

    藏花写信给包厚安，说要再去高右年家偷木雕佛像。
    白林看完信，问包厚安：“厚安，你打算怎么做呢？”
    包厚安想了想，说：“我想先去警察局见周局长，然后和他一起去见高右年。”
    白林点头说：“好，你去吧。”
    包厚安穿好衣服，拿着信，离开了。
    老何好奇地问：“白林，你不去吗？”
    白林坐下来，倒了一杯茶，然后慢悠悠地喝了一口，边喝边说：“厚安不是孩子了，你应该相信他。”
    “他才十八岁，就是个孩子！你不能让他一个人去冒险！”老何瞪着眼睛说。
    白林放下茶杯，又慢悠悠地说：“我上个月给你的书，看完了吗？如果看完了，就把作业写一下吧。”
    这好像是非常吓人的事，老何的脸色马上变了。他连忙往外面走去，边走边说：“厚安没带伞吧，快下雨了，我给他送伞去……”
    白林笑了笑，继续喝茶。
    包厚安到了警察局。周局长看完藏花的信，和他一起去高右年家了。
    高右年听说藏花还要来偷东西，气得说不出话来。儿子高游反而冷静一些，带着包厚安和周局长去了放木雕佛像的房间。
    因为有上次藏花挖地道的经历，现在佛像已经被搬到了二楼。这个房间还是没有窗，唯一的入口是进房间的门。玻璃柜放在房间的中间，柜里放着真正的木雕佛像。
    包厚安仔细检查了房间的地板和墙，在确认没问题后，又检查了门锁和钥匙。周局长站在旁边，气愤地说：“我做警察三十多年了，第一次遇到这么傲慢的小偷！这次，我要把这儿围成铁桶，看他还敢不敢来！”
    高游说：“周局长，上次您的人也把我们家围成了铁桶，但藏花还是来了。我想他是敢来的，您应该想想他来以后怎么抓住他。”
    周局长有点儿惭愧，红着脸说：“这次只要他敢来，我就一定能抓住他！”
    包厚安已经检查完了，他说：“房间没问题，我去看看下面的院子和外面的街道。”
    周局长说：“院子和街道我会安排人守着，你们放心，这次一定不会出错了！”
    今天星期四，离下个星期天还有十天。包厚安有十天的准备时间。这个时间有点儿长。藏花喜欢在对手没有防备的情况下出其不意地进攻，让对手措手不及。现在包厚安有这么长的时间来做准备，他还怎么出其不意地进攻呢？他这么做的理由是什么呢？包厚安想不明白。
fullText.traditional:
第23章、理由是什麼

    藏花寫信給包厚安，說要再去高右年家偷木雕佛像。
    白林看完信，問包厚安：“厚安，你打算怎麼做呢？”
    包厚安想了想，說：“我想先去警察局見周局長，然後和他一起去見高右年。”
    白林點頭說：“好，你去吧。”
    包厚安穿好衣服，拿著信，離開了。
    老何好奇地問：“白林，你不去嗎？”
    白林坐下來，倒了一杯茶，然後慢悠悠地喝了一口，邊喝邊說：“厚安不是孩子了，你應該相信他。”
    “他才十八歲，就是個孩子！你不能讓他一個人去冒險！”老何瞪著眼睛說。
    白林放下茶杯，又慢悠悠地說：“我上個月給你的書，看完了嗎？如果看完了，就把作業寫一下吧。”
    這好像是非常嚇人的事，老何的臉色馬上變了。他連忙往外面走去，邊走邊說：“厚安沒帶傘吧，快下雨了，我給他送傘去……”
    白林笑了笑，繼續喝茶。
    包厚安到了警察局。周局長看完藏花的信，和他一起去高右年家了。
    高右年聽說藏花還要來偷東西，氣得說不出話來。兒子高游反而冷靜一些，帶著包厚安和周局長去了放木雕佛像的房間。
    因為有上次藏花挖地道的經歷，現在佛像已經被搬到了二樓。這個房間還是沒有窗，唯一的入口是進房間的門。玻璃櫃放在房間的中間，櫃裡放著真正的木雕佛像。
    包厚安仔細檢查了房間的地板和牆，在確認沒問題後，又檢查了門鎖和鑰匙。周局長站在旁邊，氣憤地說：“我做警察三十多年了，第一次遇到這麼傲慢的小偷！這次，我要把這兒圍成鐵桶，看他還敢不敢來！”
    高游說：“周局長，上次您的人也把我們家圍成了鐵桶，但藏花還是來了。我想他是敢來的，您應該想想他來以後怎麼抓住他。”
    周局長有點兒慚愧，紅著臉說：“這次只要他敢來，我就一定能抓住他！”
    包厚安已經檢查完了，他說：“房間沒問題，我去看看下面的院子和外面的街道。”
    周局長說：“院子和街道我會安排人守著，你們放心，這次一定不會出錯了！”
    今天星期四，離下個星期天還有十天。包厚安有十天的準備時間。這個時間有點兒長。藏花喜歡在對手沒有防備的情況下出其不意地進攻，讓對手措手不及。現在包厚安有這麼長的時間來做準備，他還怎麼出其不意地進攻呢？他這麼做的理由是什麼呢？包厚安想不明白。

sentences.traditional: 今天星期四，離下個星期天還有十天。包厚安有十天的準備時間。這個時間有點兒長。
sentences.pinyin: jīn tiān xīng qī sì lí xià ge xīng qī tiān hái yǒu shí tiān bāo hòu ān yǒu shí tiān de zhǔn bèi shí jiān zhè ge shí jiān yǒu diǎn'r cháng
sentences.english: It was Thursday. There were still ten days until next Sunday. Bao Houan had ten days to prepare. This time was quite a lot of time.

sentences.simplified: 藏花喜欢在对手没有防备的情况下出其不意地进攻，让对手措手不及。
sentences.traditional: 藏花喜歡在對手沒有防備的情況下出其不意地進攻，讓對手措手不及。
sentences.pinyin: cáng huā xǐ huan zài duì shǒu méi yǒu fáng bèi de qíng kuàng xià chū qí bú yì de jìn gōng ràng duì shǒu cuò shǒu bù jí
sentences.english: Cang Hua liked to attack unexpectedly when his opponents were unprepared, catching them off guard.

sentences.simplified: 现在包厚安有这么长的时间来做准备，他还怎么出其不意地进攻呢？
sentences.traditional: 現在包厚安有這麼長的時間來做準備，他還怎麼出其不意地進攻呢？
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài bāo hòu ān yǒu zhè me cháng de shí jiān lái zuò zhǔn bèi tā hái zěn me chū qí bú yì de jìn gōng ne
sentences.english: Now that Bao Houan had so much time to make preparations, how could Cang Hua still launch a surprise attack?

sentences.simplified: 他这么做的理由是什么呢？包厚安想不明白。
sentences.traditional: 他這麼做的理由是什麼呢？包厚安想不明白。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhè me zuò de lǐ yóu shì shén me ne bāo hòu ān xiǎng bù míng bai
sentences.english: What is his reason for doing this? Bao Houan couldn’t figure it out.

sentence_translations: Chapter 23: What Is His Reason?
Cang Hua wrote a letter to Bao Houan, saying that he would go to Gao Younian’s house again to steal the wooden Buddha statue.
After Bai Lin read the letter, he asked Bao Houan, “Houan, what do you plan to do?”
Bao Houan thought about it and said, ..
.. “I want to first go to the police station to see Police Chief Zhou and then go with him to see Gao Younian.”
Bai Lin nodded and said, “Alright, you go ahead.”
Bao Houan got changed, took the letter, and left.
Old He asked curiously, “Bai Lin, aren’t you going?”
Bai Lin sat down, poured a cup of tea, and then took a leisurely sip.
While sipping, he said, “Houan isn’t a child anymore. You should trust him.”
“He’s only 18 years old. That is a child! You must not let him take risks by himself!” Old He said, glaring.
Bai Lin put down his teacup and again unhurriedly said, ..
.. “Have you finished reading the book I gave you last month? If you have, you should write your homework.”
This was a terrifying matter and Old He’s complexion immediately changed.
He promptly headed outside, saying at the same time, “Houan didn’t take an umbrella. It’s going to rain soon. I’ll take one for him …”
Bai Lin smiled and continued drinking tea.
Bao Houan arrived at the police station.
Police Chief Zhou finished reading Cang Hua’s letter and went to Gao Younian’s house with Bao Houan.
Gao Younian heard that Cang Hua was coming to steal again and was so angry that he could not speak.
His son Gao You was more composed and took Bao Houan and Police Chief Zhou to the room where the wooden Buddha statue was placed.
Because of the experience the last time when Cang Hua dug a tunnel, the Buddha statue had been moved to the second floor.
This room also didn’t have any windows. The only entrance was the door to the room.
A glass cabinet was placed in the middle of the room, and inside the cabinet was the real wooden Buddha statue.
Bao Houan carefully checked the floor and walls of the room.
After confirming that there were no issues, he also checked the door lock and key.
Police Chief Zhou stood nearby, angrily saying, ..
.. “I’ve been a police officer for over 30 years, and this is the first time I’ve encountered such an arrogant thief!
This time, I’m going to seal this place like a fortress. Let’s see if he still dares to come!”
Gao You said, “Police Chief Zhou, last time your men also sealed our house into a fortress, but Cang Hua still came.
I think he will dare to come. You should think about how to catch him after he comes.”
Police Chief Zhou was somewhat ashamed and said with a red face, “As long as he dares to come this time, I will definitely catch him!”
Bao Houan had already finished his investigation and said, ..
.. “There are no problems with the room. I will go and look at the yard downstairs and the street outside.”
Police Chief Zhou said, “I will arrange for people to guard the yard and the street. Rest assured, there will be no mistakes this time!”
It was Thursday. There were still ten days until next Sunday. Bao Houan had ten days to prepare. This time was quite a lot of time.
Cang Hua liked to attack unexpectedly when his opponents were unprepared, catching them off guard.
Now that Bao Houan had so much time to make preparations, how could Cang Hua still launch a surprise attack?
What is his reason for doing this? Bao Houan couldn’t figure it out.
